(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said columnar body comprises a polygonal cross-section that is not a cylinder.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open and said open second end has a non-uniform configuration.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body, with at least one diode mounted on each side of said columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, and the sides of the polygonal body are not straight.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/ mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/ mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open and having a non-uniform configuration, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline with no cylindrical segments.
